description: Extracts detailed electric vehicle specifications from evspecifications.com model pages, including battery, motor, performance, dimensions, range, charging, and all technical specs.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_model: 获取指定URL的完整规格数据; 需要参数 url; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_section: 获取指定URL中特定类别的规格; 需要参数 url 和 section; 参数: url, section; 必填: section, url
  - get_key_specs: 获取指定URL的关键规格摘要; 需要参数 url; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description:
EV Specifications模型页面的完整URL (例如 https://www.evspecifications.com/en/model/53a43ea)
用于 get_model, get_section, get_key_specs 功能

section.description:
要提取的规格类别关键词 (例如 battery, motor, performance, dimensions, charging, brakes, suspension)
用于 get_section 功能
